candidates.name: LANL Unified Host and Network Data Set2017
candidates.telemetry: 90days Windows host events4688/4689 and authentication, network flows
candidates.limits: Official download asks registration; no event attack ground truth published on page. Security events need separate PID-incarnation/parser adapter; not equivalent to Sysmon GUIDs

candidates.name: DARPA Operationally Transparent Cyber2019 and corrected2026 release
candidates.license: Public release; exact archive terms must be reviewed before additional acquisition
candidates.telemetry: Windows10 eCAR process/file/registry/flow provenance, large simulated enterprise with red-team narrative
candidates.status: Catalogued; original source previously quota-blocked, preprocessed mirrors excluded from training for incomplete transformation provenance
candidates.limits: Full release approximately1TB; corrected day archives12.5GB to112GB each; graph identifier corrections matter. Beyond selected bounded corpus budget

candidates.name: DARPA Transparent Computing E3/E5
candidates.telemetry: CDM provenance across CADETS/TRACE/THEIA/FiveDirections/CLEARSCOPE hosts with attack narrative/annotations
candidates.limits: Large GoogleDrive archives; heterogeneousOS/experimental sensors do not map directly to current Sysmon inputs

candidates.name: ATLASv2 Windows attack engagements
candidates.license: PaperCC-BY4.0; dataset license not found in publisher repository root (public-release access is not a substitute for dataset terms)
candidates.telemetry: Windows7 Sysmon, ETWSecurity, CarbonBlack,Firefox,DNS; actual researcher workstations plus10labattacks
candidates.limits: 154GBfullrelease; Box download separate from metadatarepo; supervised labels cover SecurityEventRecordIDs/REAPr process entities, not every Sysmon record; repeatedpayload and VMbootfootprints

candidates.name: BETH2021
candidates.license: CC0: Public Domain, verified publisherKaggleAPI dataset record
candidates.telemetry: Ubuntu18.04 AWS honeypots; kernel process-create/clone/kill plus DNS; sus/evil event annotations
candidates.limits: Linuxkernel/syscall inputs are absent from Windows polling/Sysmon. Requires independent feature contract; cannot increase Windows training volume by mixing numeric syscall IDs

candidates.name: Attack-Caused Windows OS System Calls Traces Dataset
candidates.license: No explicit license found in inspected publisher repository; not acquired
candidates.telemetry: Windows7 syscall number sequences, malware-family categories
candidates.limits: Numeric systemcalls and auditmechanism differ from WindowsSysmon; no equivalent runtime features. Does not demonstrate BigBrother detection accuracy

candidates.name: CSE-CIC-IDS2018
candidates.license: Redistribution permitted with dataset citation and AWS registry link per UNB publisher
candidates.telemetry: NetworkPCAP/CICFlowMeter and Windows/Ubuntu machine eventlogs, labattack schedule
candidates.limits: Published labels are per networkflow using schedule/IP/ports; hostevent labels require validated correlation. Network80feature CSV cannot be fed to current10token model

candidates.name: CIC-MalMem2022
candidates.license: PublisherLicense section supplies citation but no explicit grant was found; verify terms before acquisition
candidates.limits: Memorydump features are absent from current app; no process-history equivalence. Download portal may request userdetails, not fabricated credentials

candidates.name: ADFA-WD, ADFA-WD:SAA and ADFA-LD
candidates.license: Inspected UNSW source grants academicresearch use and prohibitscommercial use
candidates.limits: Source-specific noncommercial restrictions and older auditfeatures; no direct Sysmon feature adapter

candidates.name: Leipzig Intrusion Detection Dataset2019/2021
candidates.license: Publisherframework GPL-3.0-or-later; verify datasetdownload terms separately
candidates.telemetry: Linuxsystemcall traces with parameters/timing and labattack metadata
candidates.limits: Linuxcontainer/syscall signals absent from Windows runtime; executing scenarios is outside safe host tests

candidates.name: EMBER2017/2018

candidates.telemetry: StaticWindowsPE features with malwarelabels; official SHA256 archives
